question_hi: यदि क्रय मूल्य, विक्रय मूल्य का 75% है, तो लाभ प्रतिशत क्या है?
explanation:
• Let Selling Price (SP) = 100.
• Cost Price (CP) = 75% of 100 = 75.
• Profit = SP - CP = 100 - 75 = 25.
• Profit % = (Profit / CP) * 100 = (25 / 75) * 100 = 33.33%.
Hence, Option (1) [33.33%] is correct.

If $x = \frac{\sqrt{3} + 1}{\sqrt{3} - 1}$ and $y = \frac{\sqrt{3} - 1}{\sqrt{3} + 1}$, then the value of $(x^2 + y^2)$ is:

explanation:
• Rationalizing: $x = 2 + \sqrt{3}$ and $y = 2 - \sqrt{3}$.
• $x + y = 4$ and $xy = (2+\sqrt{3})(2-\sqrt{3}) = 4 - 3 = 1$.
• $x^2 + y^2 = (x + y)^2 - 2xy = 4^2 - 2(1) = 16 - 2 = 14$.
Option (1) is correct.

explanation: P(A truth) = 3/4, P(A lie) = 1/4. P(B truth) = 4/5, P(B lie) = 1/5. Contradiction = P(A truth, B lie) + P(A lie, B truth) = (3/4)(1/5) + (1/4)(4/5) = 3/20 + 4/20 = 7/20 = 35%.

question: What is the sum of cubes of the first 12 natural numbers?
question_en:
Which of the following is/are an irrational number/numbers?
(i) 0.3333...
(ii) 1.414
(iii) √2
(iv) 0.625
explanation:
The formula for the sum of cubes of the first $n$ natural numbers is:
$$\sum_{k=1}^n k^3 = \left(\frac{n(n+1)}{2}\right)^2$$
For $n = 12$:
$$\frac{12 \times 13}{2} = 6 \times 13 = 78$$
$$\text{Sum of cubes} = 78^2 = 6,084$$
Therefore, Option (2) [6084] is correct.

question: Five colleagues A, B, C, D and E come to office by car pooling and start working at their desk at the exact same time. They put their mobile phones on silent mode to avoid distractions and check their phones at fixed regular intervals for any important message. The intervals in which A, B, C, D and E check their phones are 45, 60, 30, 45 and 90 minutes, respectively. If they start working at 10:00 am sharp, at what time will all of them be checking their respective phones together for the first time?
question_en: A batch of students at a college are planning a winter vacation trip. Three options have been proposed as destinations — Shimla, Goa and Jaisalmer. 40 students are ready for both Goa and Shimla, 10 students are ready to go to any of the three destinations, and 30 students are ready for both Shimla and Jaisalmer. If 25 students want to go to Shimla only, total how many students are willing to go to Shimla?
question_hi: एक कॉलेज के विद्यार्थियों का एक दल शीतकालीन अवकाश यात्रा की योजना बना रहा है। गंतव्य के रूप में तीन विकल्पों- शिमला, गोवा और जैसलमेर का प्रस्ताव रखा गया। 40 विद्यार्थी गोवा और शिमला दोनों के लिए तैयार हैं, 10 विद्यार्थी तीनों गंतव्यों में से किसी पर भी जाने को तैयार हैं, और 30 विद्यार्थी शिमला और जैसलमेर दोनों के लिए तैयार हैं। यदि 25 विद्यार्थी केवल शिमला जाना चाहते हैं, तो कुल कितने विद्यार्थी शिमला जाने के इच्छुक हैं?
explanation:
We need to find the LCM (Lowest Common Multiple) of the checking intervals: 45, 60, 30, 45, 90 minutes.
• $45 = 3^2 \times 5$
• $60 = 2^2 \times 3 \times 5$
• $30 = 2 \times 3 \times 5$
• $90 = 2 \times 3^2 \times 5$
$\text{LCM}(45, 60, 30, 45, 90) = 2^2 \times 3^2 \times 5 = 4 \times 9 \times 5 = 180$ minutes $= 3$ hours.
Starting at 10:00 am, they will all check their phones together after 3 hours: $10:00\text{ am} + 3\text{ hours} = 1:00\text{ pm}$.
Therefore, Option (1) [1:00 pm] is correct.

question_hi: 5-अंकों वाली संख्या 3467X पर विचार कीजिए, जिसमें X इकाई अंक को निरूपित करता है। X के कितने संभावित मानों के लिए संख्या 3467X, 9 से विभाज्य होगी?
explanation:
Among ECA students (Total = 100% of ECA group):
• Every student chose at least one activity: $\text{Music} \cup \text{Sports} = 100\%$.
• $\text{Music} \cap \text{Sports} = 20\%$.
• $\text{Total Sports} = 50\% \implies \text{Sports ONLY} = 50\% - 20\% = 30\%$.
• Therefore, $\text{Music ONLY} = 100\% - \text{Total Sports} = 100\% - 50\% = 50\%$.
(Alternatively, $\text{Music ONLY} = 100\% - (30\% + 20\%) = 50\%$).
Therefore, Option (3) [50%] is correct.
